title: powerops plan status --json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops plan status --json'.

path.description: Plan folder, relative to the working folder.

status.description: draft, approved, signed-off, implementing or done; null when the header is malformed.

review.description: pending, done or skipped; null when the header is malformed.

environment.description: The header's environment: its role (Dev, Test or Prod), or a name in a plan written before M77; null when not set.

depth.description: How deep the planning questions go, or null.

supersedes.description: Folder name of the earlier plan this one replaces, or null.

openQuestions.description: Number of items under Open questions.

adminQuestions.description: Number of items under Questions for your admin.

bodyHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the plan body, or null when the header is malformed.

reports.description: The agent reports found in the plan folder, in this order when present: review.md, security-solution.md, verify.md. Empty when there is none. A report's state or staleness is never a violation: a stale plan (stale) or a stale solution (solutionStale) only warns.

state.description: The value of the 'state:' line in the report's first six lines, as written (the known values are ready, blocked, failed and dropped; any other value also adds a warning), or null when there is no such line or the file was not read (a link, a binary file or one over 1 MB). review.md normally has none.

stale.description: True when the plan body changed since the report was written, that is, the report's 'plan-hash:' differs from bodyHash. It says nothing about the solution: see solutionStale for that. Null when the report or the plan has no hash, or the file was not read.

input.description: For security-solution.md and verify.md: the value of the 'input:' line in the report's first six lines when it is a relative path (1 to 260 characters after one trailing '/' is dropped, no control character, no ':' or '\', not starting with '/', and no empty, '.' or '..' segment between '/'), else null. A present line that is not such a path also adds a warning. Always null for review.md.

solutionHash.description: For security-solution.md and verify.md: the value of the 'solution-hash:' line in the report's first six lines when it is 64 lowercase hex characters, else 'unknown' (no line, a malformed value, a report from before the line existed, or a file that was not read). Always null for review.md.

solutionStale.description: For security-solution.md and verify.md: true when the solution the report's input names now has another digest than its solution-hash, false when it has the same, null when nothing was compared: a report without a valid input and solution-hash, or a solution that is not there or could not be read (a warning says why, except for a path that is not there). Always null for review.md.

writes.description: The plan folder's write journal, writes.md, which powerops-implement keeps with one table row per tenant write it attempted; null when there is none. It never changes the exit code.

entries.description: The table's rows, header and separator lines left out; null when the file was not read (a link, a binary file or one over 1 MB).

openCleanup.description: The rows whose last cell, the cleanup obligation, is neither 'none' nor starts with 'done' (case-insensitive), so a row with no cleanup stated counts; null when the file was not read.

violations.description: Problems that make 'plan status' exit non-zero.

warnings.description: Problems that do not change the exit code.
